plugins.name: Amazon Without Sponsored
plugins.description: Hides sponsored products and ad banners from Amazon's search results and product pages, so you see what matches your search.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: AMP to Original
plugins.description: When a link opens a Google AMP copy of an article, goes to the publisher's own page instead, which is complete and isn't served through Google.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Autoscroll
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧A to have the page scroll by itself, slowly, while you read. ↑ and ↓ change the speed, Esc or ⌥⇧A stops it.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Back to Top
plugins.description: A small round button appears at the bottom right when you've scrolled far down a page, and takes you back to the top.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Bionic Reading
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧B to put the first half of each word in bold, which guides the eye and can make reading faster. Press it again to go back to the normal text.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Clean Links on Copy
plugins.description: When you copy a link or an address, tracking parts such as utm_source, fbclid and gclid are removed, so what you paste is short and doesn't follow you. Press ⌥⇧L to copy the page's clean address.

plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Colour Tools
plugins.description: Convert a colour between HEX, RGB and HSL, build palettes (shades, complement, analogous, triad) and check whether text and background colours are readable together, against the WCAG contrast rules. Offline.

plugins.name: Copy as Markdown
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧C to copy the selected text as Markdown, with its links, headings, lists, bold, italics and code. Without a selection, it copies the page's title and address as a Markdown link.
plugins.action: Copy Page or Selection as Markdown

plugins.name: Cutout
plugins.author: Cutout
plugins.description: Remove the background of any picture, on this Mac: rest the pointer on a picture and click ✂ Cutout (or press ⌥⇧X), or open Cutout and drop your own photos. Four AI engines, transparent PNG at full resolution, nothing uploaded. The engines are downloaded once when you add it (413 MB), then it works offline.

plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Dev Tools
plugins.description: A small set of tools for developers in a tab of its own: format and check JSON, Base64, URL encoding, SHA hashes, Unix times and UUIDs. It all runs on your Mac, offline.

plugins.name: Other Sites in New Tabs
plugins.description: Links that lead to a different site open in a new tab, so the page you were reading stays where it was.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Facebook, Clean
plugins.description: Hides ads, Stories, Reels, the right column and the Watch and Reels menu entries on Facebook, so you see posts from people and groups.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Fandom, Clean
plugins.description: Hides the ads, the featured video, the sticky banner and the recommendations on Fandom wikis, and the right column they sit in, so the article gets the room.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Flashcards
plugins.description: Study with flashcards in a tab of its own: make decks by typing one card per line, and review them with spaced repetition, so cards you know come back later and the ones you miss come back soon. Saved on your Mac.

plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Focus Timer
plugins.description: A focus timer in a tab of its own: 25 minutes of work and 5 of rest, or your own lengths. The time left shows in the tab's title, so you can see it from the tab list, and a soft sound says when it's done.

plugins.name: GitHub Wide
plugins.description: Lets GitHub use the whole window for code, diffs, issues and pull requests, instead of a narrow column in the middle.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Google, Just Results
plugins.description: Removes sponsored results and ads from Google Search, so the first links are real results.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Google, No AI Overview
plugins.description: Hides Google's AI Overview and the "People also ask" box on search results, and the AI Mode tab, so the first thing you see is the real results. Works in English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Dutch and Portuguese.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Grayscale Web
plugins.description: Shows every page in shades of grey, so colours stop pulling at your attention. Useful for studying, or to see how much of a site's pull is colour. Turn it off from the extensions menu.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Hide Comments
plugins.description: Hides comment sections on YouTube, news sites, blogs and Reddit, for a quieter read. Turn it off for a moment from Tacet Plugins when you want to read them.

plugins.name: Instagram, Quiet
plugins.description: Hides Reels and Explore in the menu and the Reels that show up in your feed, so the feed is the people you follow.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: JSON, Readable
plugins.description: When a page is just JSON (an API answer, a file), shows it as a tidy tree with colours, where each part can be opened or closed.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Keyboard Navigation
plugins.description: Browse without the mouse: press F to label every link, then type its letters to open it (⇧F opens it in a new tab). J and K scroll, G goes to the top and ⇧G to the bottom. Keys do nothing while you type in a field. Sites with their own single-key shortcuts, like YouTube and Gmail, keep theirs.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: LinkedIn, Quiet
plugins.description: Hides promoted posts and ads, the LinkedIn News column and the follow suggestions, leaving your feed.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Markdown Editor
plugins.description: Write Markdown on the left and read it on the right, in a tab of its own. Headings, lists, tables, quotes, code and links; it saves as you type, opens and saves .md files and copies the HTML. Offline.

plugins.name: Medium, Quiet
plugins.description: Closes Medium's sign-up pop-ups and the "Get unlimited access" bar, and lets the page scroll again, so you read the article. It doesn't open articles that Medium keeps for members.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: No Autoplay
plugins.description: Stops videos from starting by themselves on any site, even silent ones. (Tacet already blocks videos that play sound; this also stops the muted ones.) They play when you press play.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Old Reddit
plugins.description: Opens Reddit in its classic layout at old.reddit.com: lighter, faster and with more posts on screen. Galleries, chat and settings still open in the new design.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Page Outline
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧O to see the headings of the page as a list. Click one to jump to it; Esc closes the list. Good for long articles, documentation and wikis.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Password Generator
plugins.description: Makes strong random passwords in a tab of its own, with the length and kinds of characters you choose and a strength meter. Made on your Mac with secure random numbers; nothing is saved or sent.

plugins.name: Picture in Picture
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧P to float the video you're watching in its own small window, on any site, even ones that hide the button.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: QR Code
plugins.description: Make a QR code from a link, some text or your Wi-Fi details, in a tab of its own. Choose the error correction and the size and save it as PNG or SVG. It's drawn on your Mac and works offline.

plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Quiet Games
plugins.description: Three small games in a tab of its own: 2048, Snake and Minesweeper. No sound, no ads and no account, and your best scores stay on your Mac.

plugins.name: Readable Text
plugins.description: Sets text in a clear, open typeface with roomier letters, words and lines, which helps with dyslexia and long reading. Icons, code and buttons keep their own look.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Reading Progress
plugins.description: On articles, a thin bar at the top shows how far you've read, and a small label says how many minutes are left.

plugins.name: Reddit, Clean
plugins.description: Hides promoted posts and ads and the right-hand sidebar on Reddit's current design, so the page is the posts.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Redirect Skipper
plugins.description: Skips the “you are leaving” pages that Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Steam and others put between a link and the site it leads to, and goes straight to the site.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Regex Tester
plugins.description: Test regular expressions in a tab of its own: type a pattern and some text and see every match and group highlighted at once, with flags and a replace box. Offline.

plugins.name: Roblox, Quiet
plugins.description: Hides the ads and the chat window on Roblox's website, so you see your games.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Scratchpad
plugins.description: Quick notes in a tab of its own: a list of notes with search, saved on your Mac as you type, with a word count, copy and export to a text file. Nothing leaves the computer.

plugins.name: Select and Search
plugins.description: When you select a word or a phrase, a small bar appears next to it to search it on the web, Wikipedia or YouTube in a new tab. The text you select is only sent when you click one.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Skip Intro
plugins.description: Presses “Skip Intro” and “Skip Recap” for you on Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+, and answers “Are you still watching?” with Continue. It doesn't start the next episode.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Smart Dark Mode
plugins.description: Turns light sites dark with matching colours, keeps photos and videos as they are, and leaves sites that are already dark alone. Use the menu to turn it off for a site where you prefer the original.

plugins.name: Stack Overflow, Clean
plugins.description: Hides Stack Overflow's sidebars, hot questions, ads and sign-up prompts, and widens the question and answers.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Sticky Hider
plugins.description: On articles, hides headers and bars that stay stuck to the top or bottom of the window while you scroll, and newsletter and sign-up pop-ups that cover the text. Pages that are apps, like mail or documents, are left alone.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Text Only
plugins.description: Hides pictures, video and animations so only the words are left: a calmer page to read. The pictures are still loaded, they are just not shown.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: TikTok Web, Quiet
plugins.description: Hides ads and the Live, Explore and suggested accounts entries on TikTok's website, leaving For You, Following and your own pages.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: To-do
plugins.description: A simple to-do list in a tab of its own: add tasks, tick them off, star the important ones and filter by to do or done. It's kept on your Mac, and the tab's title shows how many tasks are left.

plugins.name: Twitch, Clean
plugins.description: Hides the ads over streams, the Prime and Turbo offers, and the recommended channels in the sidebar, so you see the channels you follow.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Typing Test
plugins.description: A typing speed test in a tab of its own: type a short text for 15, 30 or 60 seconds, in English, Italian or French, and see your words per minute and accuracy. Your best scores are kept on your Mac.

plugins.name: Video Frame
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧V to save the picture on screen in the video as a PNG, at the video's own size. Some sites don't allow it; then Tacet says so.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Video Speed
plugins.description: Change the speed of any video with ] and [ (in steps of 0.25×), and press \ to go back to normal. A small label shows the speed.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Video Tools
plugins.description: More keys for any video: ⌥⇧← and ⌥⇧→ jump 10 seconds, ⌥⇧↑ turns the loop on or off, ⌥⇧, and ⌥⇧. step one frame back or forward. A small label tells what happened.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Warm Night
plugins.description: A soft amber tint over every page, to be easier on the eyes in the evening. Nothing on the page changes; the tint sits on top and never blocks a click.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Wikipedia Wide
plugins.description: Lets Wikipedia use the whole window and hides the side menus, the donation banner and the edit links, leaving the article.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: Word Count
plugins.description: Press ⌥⇧W to see how many words and characters are in the text you selected, or in the whole page, and how long it takes to read.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: X Without Distractions
plugins.description: On X (Twitter), hides trends, "Who to follow", premium offers and the sidebar's suggestions, leaving your timeline and replies.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins
Tacet Plugins
plugins.name: Bigger YouTube Captions
plugins.description: Makes YouTube's subtitles larger and easier to read, on a soft dark band, in the player and in full screen.

plugins.name: YouTube Focus
plugins.description: Hides YouTube's home feed, the recommended videos next to the one you're watching and the suggestions at its end, so you watch what you came for. Search and subscriptions stay.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: YouTube, Minimal
plugins.description: Hides the end cards over the video, the merch and shopping shelves, the banners and promos, and the Mix and promoted suggestions, so the video and its title are what's left.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: YouTube, No Autoplay Next
plugins.description: Turns off YouTube's Autoplay, so the next video doesn't start when the one you're watching ends.
plugins.author: Tacet Plugins

plugins.name: YouTube without Shorts
plugins.description: Hides Shorts from YouTube's home page, search, subscriptions and sidebar, and opens any Shorts link as a normal video.
